svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-ocp-coat-abu-cut","name":"OCP coat (ABU cut) with blank name tape","size_in":{"w":42.2971,"h":38.86},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,4229.71,3886],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Outline traced from images/base/ABU_male.webp (581x719 px) at 0.0474 in/px, chosen so the coat is 29.96 in long. No real garment was measured. Sleeve cap and width were then modified by script for patch room, and the torso was widened x1.2 (estimate) so the purchase-description chest pocket fits. Length 29.96 in is about a Large Regular back length (30 in, GL/PD 14-04B Table VIIA; Medium Regular is 29-1/2); the Air Force wears this same Army OCP coat (DAFI 36-2903, which CAPR 39-1 7.1 points to) - that identity is an inference.","component_sources":{"note":"Component sizes below are from the Army purchase description GL/PD 14-04B (rev B, Mar 2023; Detail Spec, Coat, Army Combat Uniform OCP), para 3.7 and Table VIIA, M/L/XL/XXL. Read by the coordination chat and relayed to this chat; rev B differs from rev A only in the upper sleeve pocket width (4-1/2 in, was 5). They are real inches in the coat's own coordinates only if the length scale is
